mlp.extrapolation: Linear interpolation through batch 1/8/32; the 8-to-32 slope extends to batch 64.

limitations: The underlying prefill/decode service model inherits all v40/v41 limitations and is not a live serving-engine measurement.
Admission predicts only queued prefill GPU service under the hard 100 ms chunk policy. It excludes decode work between chunks, future arrivals, CPU overhead, and KV contention.
The 2/4-second backlog thresholds are controls, not production SLOs. Actual TTFT can exceed them because decode and scheduling remain outside the predictor.
Rejected requests leave immediately and are not retried, queued elsewhere, or assigned tenant priorities.
The admission policy is FCFS and does not explicitly equalize prompt length, output length, or tenant token budgets.
model: The v41 measured-service prefill/decode model with a non-escalating 100 ms prefill slice and optional 2/4-second predicted prefill-service backlog admission.

validation.accounting: The v40 base asserts exact accepted prefill/decode tokens, exact causal pairs, finite completion only for accepted requests, max batch 64, and KV within budget. Hard slices report zero budget violations; admission classifies every request exactly once.
